name: tracktor
readme_summary: Tracktor is an open-source web application built with SvelteKit for comprehensive vehicle management. It allows users to track fuel consumption, maintenance history, insurance, and regulatory documents, providing reminders and a dashboard for key metrics.
primary_use_case: Managing and tracking all aspects of multiple vehicles, including fuel, maintenance, insurance, and documents.
cover_image_prompt: A wise, old mechanic character meticulously organizing a vast, interconnected workshop. Each station represents a different vehicle, with glowing icons above them showing fuel pumps, wrenches, insurance documents, and calendar reminders. Data streams flow between the stations, converging on a central holographic dashboard displaying key vehicle metrics and upcoming renewal dates. The scene is bathed in warm, organized light, with subtle digital particles and the 'Tracktor' logo subtly integrated into a workbench. The style is a 3D isometric illustration with clean lines and a focus on clarity and organization.

name: authpass
description: AuthPass - Password Manager based on Flutter for all platforms. Keepass 2.x (KDBX 3 and KDBX 4) compatible.
readme_summary: AuthPass is an open-source, cross-platform password manager built with Flutter. It offers compatibility with KeePass 2.x (KDBX 3 and KDBX 4) databases, allowing users to securely store and manage their credentials across various devices including mobile (iOS, Android) and desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux), as well as a web interface.
key_features: Cross-platform compatibility (iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Linux, Web)
primary_use_case: To provide a unified, secure, and accessible password management solution across all major platforms, leveraging the KeePass KDBX format.
cover_image_prompt: A stylized, secure vault door with multiple distinct handles, each representing a different platform (a smartphone, a laptop, a tablet, a desktop computer). A single, glowing key, labeled 'AuthPass', is being inserted into the vault's lock. As the key turns, streams of organized, encrypted data flow out of the vault and seamlessly connect to each platform handle. The background is a clean, modern digital space with subtle circuit board patterns. The overall mood is secure, organized, and universally accessible. The art style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a vibrant yet professional color palette, emphasizing clarity and security.

name: skales
description: Personal AI desktop agent for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android & iOS. Set a goal, it works on its own. Teams (pair two desktops, agents + humans), Agent2Agent, Workflows, Codework, multi-agent orgs, desktop + browser automation. 15+ AI providers, BYOK. No Docker, no terminal. Agent Skills (SKILL.md). Migration importer. Recurring autonomous tasks.
readme_summary: Skales is a private AI desktop agent designed to perform real-world tasks autonomously on your computer. It supports multi-step workflows, team collaboration, and integrates with numerous AI providers or can run offline, offering a user-friendly, no-code installation experience across multiple platforms.
key_features: Runs on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android & iOS
primary_use_case: To act as a personal, autonomous AI assistant that performs complex, multi-step tasks on a user's computer without requiring technical expertise or cloud-based services.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, anthropomorphic robot diligently working at a cluttered but organized desk, surrounded by floating icons representing various tasks: a calendar, a code editor, a browser window, and a file folder. The robot is actively manipulating a stream of digital 'data' flowing from a laptop towards a larger, glowing 'goal' icon. Subtle UI elements of the Skales application are visible on the laptop screen. The background is a cozy, slightly blurred home office setting, emphasizing the personal and local nature of the AI. The overall style is a warm, inviting 3D isometric illustration with soft lighting and a color palette of blues, greens, and warm wood tones, conveying productivity and ease of use.

name: presidio
description: An open-source framework for detecting, redacting, masking, and anonymizing sensitive data (PII) across text, images, and structured data. Supports NLP, pattern matching, and customizable pipelines.
readme_summary: Presidio is an open-source SDK for detecting, redacting, masking, and anonymizing sensitive Personally Identifiable Information (PII) within text, images, and structured data. It offers a pluggable and customizable framework that supports various recognition methods, including NLP and pattern matching, to help organizations maintain data privacy and compliance.
key_features: PII detection and anonymization for text and images
Pluggable and customizable recognizers (NLP, regex, etc.)
Support for predefined and custom PII entities
Extensible pipeline for custom de-identification flows
primary_use_case: Detecting, redacting, masking, and anonymizing sensitive data (PII) in text, images, and structured data to ensure privacy and compliance.
cover_image_prompt: A wise old librarian meticulously sifting through a vast, ancient library filled with scrolls and books. The librarian uses a magnifying glass that glows with a soft, protective aura, revealing hidden symbols of sensitive information (like credit card numbers or social security icons) within the texts. As these symbols are identified, they are instantly replaced by a gentle, blurred effect or a simple placeholder icon, ensuring the original content remains intact but anonymized. The library itself is filled with subtle digital data streams and glowing nodes, representing the underlying technology. The overall mood is one of careful protection and clarity, rendered in a detailed digital painting style with a warm, inviting color palette.

name: beatsync
description: 🔊 High-precision web player for multi-device audio playback and spatial audio.
readme_summary: Beatsync is a high-precision web audio player designed for synchronized multi-device playback. It leverages NTP-inspired time synchronization to ensure millisecond-accurate audio across different devices, offering features like spatial audio and a polished, self-hostable interface.
primary_use_case: Synchronizing audio playback across multiple devices with high precision for a shared listening experience.
cover_image_prompt: A conductor leading an orchestra where each musician is a distinct, modern device (laptop, tablet, phone). The conductor's baton is a beam of light, precisely directing the audio flow to each device, ensuring they play in perfect, millisecond-accurate harmony. Subtle visual cues like sound waves emanating from the baton and glowing lines connecting the devices to a central clock icon emphasize the synchronization. Small, abstract UI elements representing volume and spatial positioning float around the scene. The overall mood is one of precise, harmonious digital performance. The art style should be a vibrant, 3D isometric illustration with a clean, futuristic aesthetic, highlighting the seamless integration and control.
